rule: 4 spaces indentation; tabs strictly forbidden except in Makefiles
notes: Indent width 4 spaces; tabs in C source fail checkpatch

rule: Line length limit of 80 characters
notes: Lines exceeding 80 columns generate warning/error in checkpatch

rule: Braces mandatory for all control blocks (if, for, while) even for single statements
notes: Prevents dangling else and accidental multi-statement bugs

rule: Naming conventions: lower_case_with_underscores for variables, CamelCase for types
notes: Structured typedefs use CamelCase; scalars use lower_case_with_underscores_t

rule: Traditional C comments /* ... */ required; C99 // comments discouraged in C code
notes: checkpatch flags C99 comments in C source files

rule: Use GLib memory allocation functions (g_malloc, g_new, g_free), never raw libc malloc
notes: g_malloc aborts on OOM; raw malloc strictly forbidden in emulator core

rule: Error handling must use Error **errp object pattern or GError
notes: Provides rich error context and propagation across QMP and device models

rule: Changes must pass make check and ninja test without regressions
notes: Runs unit tests, qtest device emulation tests, and avocado integration tests

rule: GitLab CI verifies build and test matrix across architectures
notes: Runs cross-builds and QEMU-based smoke test suite

rule: Commit subject line prefixed with subsystem (e.g. xen/arm: ...), wrapped at 72 chars
notes: Concise summary in imperative mood

rule: New source files must start with single-line SPDX-License-Identifier comment
notes: REUSE-IgnoreStart Format: /* SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only */ REUSE-IgnoreEnd

rule: Signed-off-by trailer required under Developer Certificate of Origin
notes: Certifies contribution under DCO; verified by maintainers

rule: Patches sent via git-send-email to xen-devel@lists.xenproject.org with maintainers CC'd
notes: Maintainers determined by scripts/get_maintainer.pl

rule: Adherence to documented subset of MISRA C:2012 safety rules
notes: Formal MISRA compliance guidelines documented in docs/misra/rules.rst

rule: Security vulnerabilities must follow confidential disclosure process; no public postings
notes: Reported directly to security@xenproject.org under Xen Security Policy

rule: 4 space indentation; tabs forbidden in hypervisor code (in contrast to Linux)
notes: Indent level is 4 spaces; tabs prohibited in xen/*

rule: Enclosing braces of a block indented the same as code outside the block
notes: Opening and closing braces indented at enclosing scope level

rule: Maximum line width 80 characters
notes: Statements wrapped cleanly to fit within 80 columns

rule: Braces mandatory for all control blocks (if, for, while)
notes: Single statement branches must use braces

rule: Traditional C comments /* ... */ exclusively
notes: C99 // comments forbidden in hypervisor core
